games.name: Twisted [BETA]
games.desc:
**This game will NOT run well on low end devices!**

Twisted is a storm chasing game by Willzuh and Siryzm.

Throughout the rolling hills and prairies of the fictional state of Keysota, scientists and thrill seekers alike set out on the roads in chase of severe weather. Some will observe from a safe distance, while others will risk it all to get the perfect shot of a violent tornado from close range. Whether you're out there deploying data-collecting probes, intercepting in an armored vehicle, or just taking pictures, you're bound to have a run in with mother nature like no other. Just watch yourself, sometimes the hunters become the hunted. 

Connect with us through our social links (below this), where you can talk to others about the game, view change logs, announcements, and make suggestions.

Developers:
Willzuh - Builder
Siryzm - Programmer

Special thanks to our contributors for making this possible!

games.name: [⏰FASHIONABLY LATE] Die of Death
games.desc:
UPDATE LOG: Fashionably Late Update. This update includes tons of new major content and reworks. Nearly everything in the game has been changed up to some extent, check it out!

Die of Death is a notably inconsistent game when it comes to strategy and often requires adapting on the fly to win. This game does an unique spin on the asymmetrical-horror genre, taking a more light and unserious tone when it comes to its content & gameplay! Randomness is a key factor here, with gamemodes that appear in between matches, random ability decks survivors are forced to pick in order to live, and more!

NOTHING IN THIS GAME FINAL, EXPECT CHANGES IN THE FUTURE!

Thumbnail & game icon both by @Chiprit103!

games.name: Project Delta
games.desc:
Survive in a post-apocalyptic world following a catastrophic nuclear power plant disaster. Scavenge for superior equipment and conquer the wastelands to become their ruler. Decide whether to work with your faction or betray it. The fate of your legacy is in your hands.

This game is a true test of your survival and PvP skills. Prepare to face challenges that will test your abilities to the fullest.

Experience the ultimate gaming immersion with state-of-the-art Roblox graphics, featuring full PBR materials.

Please be aware that this game is still in development and does not represent the final product. Expect frequent updates and occasional restarts. While your skins and delta currency will be retained, player inventories and non-permanent items may be reset with significant updates.

Special Credits:
We are inspired by the original Deadzone on Roblox and express our sincere appreciation to its creator for the incredible game idea that ignited our own creative journey.
